usage.callShape: POST https://api.paysponge.com/x402/purchase/svc_d5zgtpg00dvssgj28/chat/completions with OpenAI-compatible JSON body {model, messages[], max_tokens}; pay $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base (or Solana)
usage.outputShape: body.choices[0].message.content (OpenAI chat-completion shape); token/cost info in body.usage
quirks: inputSchema is empty but the body is NOT optional: you MUST send a `model` field or it 402-charges then returns 400 {error:'No models provided'}.
Backend is an OpenRouter proxy. Use OpenRouter-style model names (e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini', returned as 'openai/gpt-4o-mini').

CRITICAL: you MUST set a low `max_tokens` (e.g. 50-200). With the default (16384) OpenRouter rejects with a 402 'requires more credits, or fewer max_tokens' error — that 402 is an upstream credit error, NOT an x402 payment-required, and (in this gateway) was NOT charged.
Each successful or pre-flight-valid x402 call costs $0.01 USDC regardless of model/token usage. The first attempt without `model` still charged $0.01 before 400ing.
Response is verbatim OpenRouter output: includes provider, system_fingerprint, native_finish_reason, and usage.cost (real upstream inference cost, fractions of a cent).
usage.guide: Send a POST to the URL with an OpenAI-style JSON body that MUST include `model` (use an OpenRouter model id like 'gpt-4o-mini'), `messages`, and a low `max_tokens` (e.g. 50-200) — omitting model 400s after charging, and a high/default max_tokens triggers an upstream OpenRouter credit 402. Each call costs $0.01 USDC paid automatically via x402 on Base. Read the assistant reply at body.choices[0].message.content. The response is raw OpenRouter format including a body.usage block with token counts and real upstream cost.
